candidate_relations.reason: Eosinophilic granuloma is an osseous LCH form, but the record demonstrates both cutaneous disease and skull lesions, supporting multisystem involvement.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Localized osseous Langerhans cell histiocytosis rather than multisystem LCH

candidate_relations.reason: Indeterminate cell histiocytosis is separate from Langerhans cell histiocytosis and does not account for the characteristic CD1a-positive Langerhans-cell infiltrate with osteolytic skull disease as the benchmark diagnosis does.
Multicentric reticulohistiocytosis has different histopathology and typically features papulonodular skin disease with destructive polyarthritis, which are not described.
The biopsy morphology, eosinophil-rich infiltrate, CD1a positivity, and osteolytic skull lesions support Langerhans cell histiocytosis rather than lymphoma.
Chronic treatment-resistant scalp lesions with CD1a-positive histiocytic infiltration and osteolytic skull lesions indicate multisystem LCH, not an infectious disease.
